stages.label: Independent research
stages.instructions: Ask provenance-grok and provenance-gemini independently to analyze issue 22 and the current workflow, message, persistence, CLI, MCP, retrospective, and migration contracts. Send each request with workflowContext for this run, research stage, the matching required-evidence key, and the current one-based attempt. At checkpoint, cite the replied message IDs through evidenceRefs. Capture agreements, contradictions, threat cases, and acceptance criteria in a research synthesis under .kxm/assets.
requiredEvidence: Grok message ID and replied result
Gemini message ID and replied result

stages.label: Reviewed architecture plan
stages.instructions: Ask both peers for independent implementation plans using one shared workflowContext bound to this run, plan stage, the independent-plan-message-IDs requirement, and the current attempt. Synthesize a backward-compatible schema for evidence type, producer identity or role, quorum, terminal state, message binding, and explicit degraded policy. Define persistence and migration, validation boundaries, all affected interfaces, tests, documentation, rollout, and rollback. Cite both replied message IDs through evidenceRefs.

stages.label: Implementation
stages.instructions: Implement the reviewed plan as the sole writer. Verify peer evidence against durable hub state and unique producers. Pending, expired, cancelled, duplicated, wrong-run, wrong-stage, or coordinator-authored substitute evidence must not satisfy a peer quorum. Permit degradation only through an explicit journaled policy branch. Preserve readable legacy string evidence and keep Pi, MCP, webhook, CLI, retrospective, documentation, and generated bundles aligned.

stages.label: Complete local gates
stages.instructions: Run the complete repository validation gate, generated-artifact check, strict Claude marketplace validation, package inspection, and isolated packed CLI/hub smoke on supported Node engines. Record and resolve every warning or failure.

stages.label: Independent implementation review
stages.instructions: Give Grok and Gemini the actual diff and ask them independently to review provenance integrity, authorization, uniqueness, correlation, migration, degradation visibility, interface parity, tests, portability, and documentation. Send each request with workflowContext bound to this run, review stage, its matching review requirement, and the current attempt; cite both replied message IDs through evidenceRefs. Resolve every material finding and rerun affected gates.

stages.label: Deliver and watch
stages.instructions: Commit and push the reviewed increment, open a pull request closing issue 22, add it to Project 3, and watch every required GitHub check. Merge only when all required checks pass and the evidence verifier confirms the independent-review quorum.

stages.label: Continuous-improvement retrospective
stages.instructions: Export and review the durable retrospective. Record timing, contradictions, errors, degraded paths, manual interventions, and measurable follow-ups. Separate verified peer evidence from coordinator synthesis and do not silently promote proposed policy.
